message.reasoning_content: The user asks for 17 * 23. I can split 23 into 20 and 3. 17 * 20 = 340. 17 * 3 = 51. So the product is 340 + 51. Let me check that another way before I answer. 23 * 17 = 23 * 10 + 23 * 7 = 230 + 161. Now 230 + 161, adding the hundreds first, then the tens. Both routes should agree, so I will compare them digit by digit. Starting again from 17 * 20
